description: Split a series of recurring sessions where attendance varies: each session's cost is shared only by that session's attendees, then payments already made are netted into balances and minimal settle-up transfers. Use for weekly games or leagues. For a single event use split_costs.

currency.description: Currency code used only for display, e.g. USD (default USD)

payments.description: Optional list of who already paid what across the series, e.g. [{"name":"Asha","paid":120}]

name.description: Player who paid, e.g. the person who fronted court fees

paid.description: Total amount this player has paid across the series, in currency units

players.description: Optional full roster, so players who missed every session still appear with a zero balance

sessions.description: Sessions in order, each with its cost and the names who attended

attendees.description: Unique names of players present at this session

cost.description: Cost of this session in currency units, e.g. 60

name: split_series

note.description: Explanation of how the series was split

players.description: Per-player paid, owed, balance and sessions attended

balance.description: paid minus owed; positive = gets money back, negative = owes money

owed.description: This player's fair share of the cost

sessions_played.description: Number of sessions this player attended

per_head.description: Cost per attendee for this session

amount.description: Amount to transfer, rounded to cents

title: Split series
